content:
I tried to change the IMAP server address for an existing T-bird account

Don't change an existing account. Create a new account for the new server.

T-bird and/or my ISP deleted the saved password and IMAP server line for that account in T-bird's Saved Passwords table, so T-bird cannot get incoming E-mails.

When this is an existing account, you'll have to authenticate once, and tell Thunderbird to remember the password. It will then be stored in Tools -> Options -> Privacy & Security -> Passwords -> Saved Passwords.

If this is an account using OAuth2 authentication, Thunderbird will only remember an authentication token, and not the actual account password.

In any case, you'll have to enter your account password once to regain access to the account. If you forgot the password, check with your email provider about password reset options.
